I've replied to you in our DM thread with two of the three answers. I couldn't tell which ticket goes with the Moorland rollout.

1. Main contact: Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations, according to the North team cheat sheet.
2. Seat count for Amendment No. 1: 185. Dana first posted 180 in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later.
3. Ticket number: nothing I can see mentions a "Moorland rollout." These are the two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets I found:
   - #4419: your note from 14 Jul 2025 says it's about Gate 3 printer lag. The cheat sheet describes it differently: scanners at Door 14 not reading trailer tags, escalated to the second-tier support team.
   - #PD-4492: Thea logged it on 4 Oct 2025 because the Eau Claire yard kiosk wasn't texting drivers their bay assignments. Support patched it.

I asked you to tell me which one is the Moorland ticket, or to send the ticket number if it's in a place I haven't seen.

I only looked in places you can see yourself: #north-team, #inc-qfl-sev1, our DM and public files. All of these details are account operations facts, not finance figures, so you're fine to have them.
